title: Basic Browser Setup
description: Configure browser access and Playwright, save verified locators, capture video plus console/network evidence, and establish reporting.
setup_prompt: Use Basic Browser Setup for my application. Reuse existing configuration, discover and save verified locators, configure Playwright or my chosen runner, execute a saved smoke test from a fresh context, retain redacted video and console/network evidence, and produce a reusable profile and live report.

setup_inputs.label: Account roles and authorized authentication
setup_inputs.required_when: The agreed smoke behavior requires authentication

setup_inputs.label: Existing test project or authorized test source location
Video, console/network evidence, and retention policy

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Explore the application and collect supported video, console, network, error, screenshot, and trace evidence

recommended_tools.name: Playwright CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Preferred repeatable test runner; preserve an explicitly selected equivalent

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks browser recording
recommended_tools.purpose: Capture smoke video plus redacted console/network diagnostics and expose durable evidence in the report

recommended_tools.name: Issue-tracker MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Connect an explicitly chosen destination for setup blockers

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Browser profiles, session boundaries, and reusable test helpers
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Fitness of browser evidence for release decisions
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Configured repeatable smoke suite and runner invocation
Attempt-scoped video, console logs, and network logs or explicit capture limitations
Saved smoke-test result or explicit blocker
Application knowledgebase note with verified locators and test setup
